summary: Two renderer findings on evidence surfaces: figure numbering is incomplete (only mapPackage.js carries figure_number=1; chart sections and renderChartHeader don't honor figure_number), and the replay token is truncated to 32 chars in Appendix E + Build Attestation, breaking PDF-as-verifier surface without the JSON sidecar.

findings.title: Figure numbering incomplete — only mapPackage.js:32 carries figure_number=1; chart sections and renderChartHeader don't honor figure_number
findings.recommended_fix: Propagate figure_number through chart sections and renderChartHeader. Downstream of the PR-RENDER orphan-section fix — figures in re-imported sections (RF Exposure, Tower Study, Build Attestation) also need sequential numbering wiring.
tests_required: snapshot test asserting Figure 1..Figure N sequential numbering across exhibit sections
findings.reproducibility_notes: Render any FM exhibit and observe that only the map-package figure is numbered; chart sections render captions without 'Figure N:' prefix.

findings.title: Replay token truncated to 32 chars in Appendix E + Build Attestation — PDF can't be used as verifier surface without the JSON sidecar
findings.recommended_fix: Print the full replay token (or a structured truncation with hash) in Appendix E and the Build Attestation so the PDF surface alone is sufficient to re-derive the exhibit identity. Currently the 32-char truncation forces a JSON-sidecar dependency.
tests_required: assert replay-token strings in Appendix E / Build Attestation are either full-length or include a content-hash suffix
findings.reproducibility_notes: diff token printed in Appendix E vs token returned by identity sidecar; current truncation drops the last ~32 chars.
